coordinates.locator: OSM/Nominatim polygon for "Thomas Jefferson National Accelerator Facility" (12000 Jefferson Avenue), centroid; JLab site-plan address agrees
coordinates.note: Correction: the previous ROR-geocoded point (36.98038, -76.42975) was about 13 km from the laboratory; the OSM campus polygon and Jefferson Lab's own site plan both place the campus at 12000 Jefferson Avenue, Newport News. Previous record: campus point 36.98038, -76.42975 at 800 m precision, sources ['src:facilities-verify-jlab-ror', 'src:jlab-wikipedia']; moved 6537 m (2026-09-21).

summary.plain: The Jefferson Lab campus in Newport News, Virginia, home to the CEBAF particle accelerator.
summary.technical: 214-acre DOE national-laboratory campus in Newport News, Virginia, hosting the CEBAF recirculating superconducting electron linac.
